title: Backup and export
subtitle: Your data in open formats, at any time.
exportNote: Exports never contain passwords, keys, tokens or attachments. The download needs a recent sign-in confirmation.
importBody: Loads a JSON export into this household. Only possible while it has no transactions yet.
yearEndBody: Accounts, holdings at cost and debts on 31 December, as CSV or a printable page. No tax calculation.
backupBody: Daily encrypted database backups run on the server (see the README for restore). They are separate from these exports.
